notes.title: The General Fixes Update
notes.notes:
Hey there!

We are aware of an issue related to Coin images not properly loading sometimes in your inventories, we have been trying multiple fixes and the images usually load much better now. Work is - unfortunately for us - not over yet, and some of your Coins images might still not load properly on Steam. 

Your Coins are of course still there in all cases, you only need to check back in a little while so the image can try loading again. This is an issue related to server load. 

We will continue trying to deploy a final solution to this issue. If you notice any weird behaviour, as in an image loading in place of another, let us know by opening a discussion or leaving a comment providing a screeshot, your feedback is valuable! ːsteamhappyː


Have a good day boys!ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: The Achievement Update Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!

After you guys let us knew yesterday of a weird behaviour with fat stacks of Coins, we just now figured the issue and deployed a hotfix, which should be live right now, making sure Coin stacks are being counted as they should. 

Please, run your games for half a minute to check for achievements! 

A huge, huge thanks once more for your feedback, we wouldn't be here today if it weren't because of you! ːsteamthumbsupːːsteamthumbsupːːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: The Achievement Update
notes.notes:
Hello there and Happy New Year 2025!

To celebrate the occasion we have done something long overdue - we have reworked the achievement system, now including 12 of them! ːsteamhappyː


Here is just a sneak peek into some of the new (and old) ones: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097718/af80e9b3238becc49dfc5378e290d877a182d6cd.png



Check them all following this link: 

https://steamcommunity.com/id/CoinsDev/stats/3083090/achievements/



No new Coins today boys, but we are sure the achievements are gonna be equally as fun to collect!

One way or the other, keep collecting, have a great day and year! ːsteamthumbsupː
